FRIERENMOD-HOLY_EMBLEM.title: Holy Emblem
FRIERENMOD-HOLY_EMBLEM.description: At the start of each turn, add 1 [gold]Mana[/gold] to your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] and [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
FRIERENMOD-HOLY_EMBLEM.flavor: An old [gold]mage[/gold] certification. The organizations governing magic keep changing, much to [gold]Frieren[/gold]’s annoyance.
FRIERENMOD-EAR_ACCESSORY.title: Elegant Ear Ornament
FRIERENMOD-EAR_ACCESSORY.description: At the start of combat, add 2 [gold]Mana[/gold] to your hand.
FRIERENMOD-EAR_ACCESSORY.flavor: The earrings [gold]Frieren[/gold] has always worn seem to match those of her master, [gold]Flamme[/gold].
FRIERENMOD-FAKE_FLAMME_GRIMOIRE.title: Flamme's Grimoire(Fake)
FRIERENMOD-FAKE_FLAMME_GRIMOIRE.descript: On the first turn of combat, you can play [gold]Legendary Spells[/gold] without first playing a [gold]Chant[/gold] card.
FRIERENMOD-FAKE_FLAMME_GRIMOIRE.flavor: Everyone knows that the [gold]grimoires attributed to Flamme[/gold] are fakes. Perhaps [gold]the real one[/gold] awaits in some secret place...
FRIERENMOD-FLAMME_GRIMOIRE.title: Flamme's Grimoire
FRIERENMOD-FLAMME_GRIMOIRE.description: You can play [gold]Legendary Spells[/gold] without first playing a [gold]Chant[/gold] card.
FRIERENMOD-FLAMME_GRIMOIRE.flavor: At the northernmost edge of the continent, I reached [gold]the land where souls rest[/gold], the place people call [gold]heaven[/gold]...
FRIERENMOD-HAIR_ACCESSORY.title: Fern's Hair Ornament
FRIERENMOD-HAIR_ACCESSORY.flavor: A gift from [gold]Frieren[/gold] to her apprentice [purple]Fern[/purple] on her sixteenth birthday.
FRIERENMOD-HAITAA_WAND.title: Heiter's Staff
FRIERENMOD-HAITAA_WAND.description: Deprecated. Cannot be obtained and has no effect.
FRIERENMOD-HAITAA_WAND.flavor: A staff left behind by Heiter.
FRIERENMOD-HIMMEL_GRAVESTONE.title: Himmel's Gravestone
FRIERENMOD-HIMMEL_GRAVESTONE.description: Gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} at the start of each turn. Upon pickup, add [gold]The Pain of Longevity[/gold] to your deck.
FRIERENMOD-HIMMEL_GRAVESTONE.flavor: [blue]Himmel[/blue], the hero who defeated the [red]Demon King[/red], loved [gold]Frieren[/gold], though she failed to notice in time. After he passed on to [gold]heaven[/gold], he inspired [gold]Frieren[/gold] to embark on a journey to understand humans.
FRIERENMOD-ICICLE_CHERRY_BLOSSOM.title: Icicle Cherry Blossom
FRIERENMOD-ICICLE_CHERRY_BLOSSOM.descrip: Gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} at the start of each turn. Each card offered in a card reward has a 60% chance to be replaced with [gold]Mana[/gold].
FRIERENMOD-ICICLE_CHERRY_BLOSSOM.flavor: [gold]Icicle cherry blossoms[/gold] bloom in winter. Their flowers are poisonous, yet beautiful. They are also [gold]Frieren[/gold]'s favorite winter flowers.
FRIERENMOD-IMMOVABLE_CLOAK.title: Immovable Cloak
FRIERENMOD-IMMOVABLE_CLOAK.description: Draw 1 additional card each turn until you lose HP during combat.
FRIERENMOD-IMMOVABLE_CLOAK.flavor: A cloak enchanted by Burg, a [gold]first-class mage[/gold]. Its powerful [gold]defensive spells[/gold] kept ordinary examinees from pushing him back even half a step, until [green]one examinee[/green] cut through him, cloak and all.
FRIERENMOD-MERCURY_PUDDING.title: Mercury Pudding
FRIERENMOD-MERCURY_PUDDING.description: At the end of combat, if you have 10 HP or less, heal [green]50%[/green] of your [green]max HP[/green]. Works only once.
FRIERENMOD-MERCURY_PUDDING.flavor: A dessert [gold]Frieren[/gold] enjoys, and one of the things that inspired [gold]Frieren[/gold] to understand humans.
FRIERENMOD-MICKEY_HOUSE.title: Unbelievable House
FRIERENMOD-MICKEY_HOUSE.description: Whenever you enter an event room, gain an [gold]Unbelievable Tool[/gold].
FRIERENMOD-MICKEY_HOUSE.flavor: The [red]mouse[/red] here always has some strange [gold]Unbelievable Tools[/gold] to offer.
FRIERENMOD-MIMIC_HEAD.title: Mimic's Head
FRIERENMOD-MIMIC_HEAD.description: Whenever you open a [gold]chest[/gold], gain 100 additional Gold.
FRIERENMOD-MIMIC_HEAD.flavor: Somewhere dark, a rumor says that wearing a [gold]mimic's head[/gold] brings more loot. Wuxiu~~ Singing and dancing, Frieren tumbles into a [red]mimic[/red]'s mouth once again.
FRIERENMOD-MIRRORED_LOTUS_RING.title: Mirrored-Lotus Ring
FRIERENMOD-MIRRORED_LOTUS_RING.descripti: At the start of turn 4, add [gold]Himmel[/gold] to your hand.
FRIERENMOD-MIRRORED_LOTUS_RING.flavor: [gold]Frieren[/gold] chose it on a whim. [blue]Himmel[/blue] bought it for her and slipped it onto her finger himself. Only after [blue]Himmel[/blue]'s death did [gold]Frieren[/gold] learn that the mirrored lotus means [blue]eternal love[/blue].
FRIERENMOD-OLD_HAIR_ACCESSORY.title: Fern's Hair Ornament
FRIERENMOD-OLD_HAIR_ACCESSORY.flavor: A gift from [gold]Frieren[/gold] to her apprentice [purple]Fern[/purple] on her sixteenth birthday.
FRIERENMOD-SCALE_OF_OBEDIENCE.title: Scale Of Obedience
FRIERENMOD-SCALE_OF_OBEDIENCE.descriptio: At the end of your turn, if any pile contains Mana, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} next turn.
FRIERENMOD-SCALE_OF_OBEDIENCE.flavor: A powerful magical instrument belonging to [red]Aura the Guillotine[/red], one of the [red]Seven Sages of Destruction[/red]. It weighs her soul against her opponent's, placing the one with less mana under her complete control.
FRIERENMOD-STATUE_OF_HIMMEL.title: Statue Of Himmel
FRIERENMOD-STATUE_OF_HIMMEL.description: At the start of each of your first 3 turns, gain 1 [gold]Artifact[/gold] if you have none.
FRIERENMOD-STATUE_OF_HIMMEL.flavor: [blue]Himmel[/blue] had statues of himself built across the land so the world would remember him, and the [gold]Frieren[/gold] of the future would not feel alone. Even a hundred years later, people still care for [blue]Himmel[/blue]'s statues.
FRIERENMOD-STILLE.title: Stille
FRIERENMOD-STILLE.description: At the start of combat, gain 2 [gold]Dexterity[/gold]. At the end of turn 3, lose 2 [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
FRIERENMOD-STILLE.flavor: Its top speed exceeds the speed of sound, and it is highly sensitive to mana. During the mage certification exam, [gold]Frieren[/gold] caught one with a [gold]bird-catching spell[/gold].
FRIERENMOD-UBEL_STAFF.title: Übel's Staff
FRIERENMOD-UBEL_STAFF.description: Every 6 [gold]Chant[/gold] cards played, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}. Progress carries over between combats.
FRIERENMOD-UBEL_STAFF.flavor: [green]Übel[/green] is known for her unique talents, [gold]“Empathy”[/gold] and [gold]“a spell that cuts almost anything”[/gold]. A slash from her staff once sliced through Burg, the [gold]first-class mage[/gold] wearing the Immovable Cloak.
FRIERENMOD-COMFORTABLE_BED.title: Comfortable Bed
FRIERENMOD-COMFORTABLE_BED.description: Gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} at the start of each turn. At the start of combat, add a [gold]Laziness[/gold] to your draw pile and discard pile.
FRIERENMOD-COMFORTABLE_BED.flavor: Even [gold]Frieren[/gold], a great mage who has lived for over a thousand years, cannot escape its [red]restraints[/red]. Such is its power.
FRIERENMOD-UPGRADED_HOLY_EMBLEM.title: Upgraded Holy Emblem
FRIERENMOD-UPGRADED_HOLY_EMBLEM.descript: At the start of each turn, add 1 [gold]Mana[/gold] to your draw pile, hand, and discard pile.
FRIERENMOD-UPGRADED_HOLY_EMBLEM.flavor: Your [gold]outstanding performance[/gold] has earned this [gold]mage[/gold] certification the recognition of every magical organization.
FRIERENMOD-KRAFT_SERPENT_RING.title: Ring of the Serpent
FRIERENMOD-KRAFT_SERPENT_RING.flavor: A parting gift from [gold]Kraft the elf[/gold].
FRIERENMOD-AURA_COMPANION.title: Pet Aura
FRIERENMOD-AURA_COMPANION.description:
Aura will accompany you in combat, forever...
Original animation by @肯Kenenk on Bilibili.
FRIERENMOD-AURA_COMPANION.flavor: Defeated by her own [red]obedience magic[/red], [red]Aura[/red] became your most loyal [gold]violinist[/gold].
FRIERENMOD-KNIGHT_SECRET.title: The Knight's Secret
FRIERENMOD-KNIGHT_SECRET.description: Whenever you take unblocked damage, gain 1 [gold]Shape of Unn[/gold].
FRIERENMOD-KNIGHT_SECRET.flavor: The [gold]ultimate secret[/gold] earned at the cost of dignity. Its power is beyond doubt.
FRIERENMOD-MAGIC_SHOP_MEMBERSHIP.title: Magic Shop Membership
FRIERENMOD-MAGIC_SHOP_MEMBERSHIP.descrip: Visiting the magic shop does not consume your Rest Site action.
FRIERENMOD-MAGIC_SHOP_MEMBERSHIP.flavor: You and the shopkeeper [gold]Richter[/gold] got to know each other through a fight in the mage exam. Now you can come and go from the [gold]magic shop[/gold] as you please.
FRIERENMOD-GAMBLER_COIN.title: Gambler's Coin
FRIERENMOD-GAMBLER_COIN.description: Lose all your Gold. Add [gold]Honest Work Is Boring, Right?[/gold] to your [gold]deck[/gold].
FRIERENMOD-GAMBLER_COIN.flavor: The priest [gold]Sein[/gold] lost all his Gold at the casino. With this [gold]last coin[/gold], you decide to show him what a [gold]real gambler[/gold] can do.
FRIERENMOD-GHOST_IN_BLOOM.title: Stand: Ghost in Bloom
FRIERENMOD-GHOST_IN_BLOOM.description: After you [gold]shuffle[/gold], add a [gold]Blue Moon Weed[/gold] to your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
FRIERENMOD-GHOST_IN_BLOOM.flavor: [i]That familiar face is gone, I know not where; peach blossoms still smile in the spring breeze[/i]. [gold]“Ghost in Bloom”[/gold] signifies that your [blue]Flower Field Spell[/blue] has reached its pinnacle, and reflects your quiet, lingering longing for [blue]that person[/blue]...
FRIERENMOD-MATRYOSHKA.title: Matryoshka
FRIERENMOD-MATRYOSHKA.description: The next 2 non-Boss chests contain an additional [gold]Relic[/gold].
FRIERENMOD-MATRYOSHKA.flavor: A stackable set of painted dolls. The paint depicts an unknown bird with white eyes and blue feathers.
